note: RFC 7440 Section 3: 'The specified value MUST be less than or equal to the value specified by the client.' TestRFC7440ServerAcknowledgesWindowsize asserts the exact grant: 8 gives 8 and 64 gives 64 (red if the server grants its maximum regardless), 1000 and 65535 give 64 (red if it echoes the request above its maximum), plus granted <= asked on every case; 0, 65536 and abc are not acknowledged beside blksize. Producer grantWindowsize min(requested, maximum) and sendOACKAndWait.
